In the context of a hypothetical, write the jacket blurb for a thriller where a modern day operative of the FBI, ends up back in the early 1960's having to use her knowledge of "future" forensics to leave clues to enable her modern colleagues to catch a time-hopping serial-killer, before he dies.assistant
response:
"When FBI operative Rachel Jenkins is sent back in time to the early 1960s, she finds herself in the midst of a decades-old mystery. A serial killer, known only as 'The Timekeeper,' has been terrorizing the nation, leaving a trail of bodies in his wake. But this is no ordinary killer - he's a time-hopper, able to move through the ages with ease.

As Rachel navigates the unfamiliar streets of 1960s America, she must use her knowledge of future forensics to leave clues that will help her modern colleagues catch the killer. But with the Timekeeper always one step ahead, Rachel must rely on her wits and cunning to stay alive.

With the help of a local detective, Jack, Rachel sets out to unravel the mystery of the Timekeeper's true identity and motives. But as they dig deeper, they realize that the killer's actions are not just random - they're part of a larger game, one that spans centuries.

As the body count rises, Rachel and Jack must work together to outsmart the Timekeeper and bring him to justice. But with the clock ticking down, they know they're running out of time. Can they solve the mystery before the Timekeeper strikes again, or will he continue to leave a trail of death and destruction in his wake?

The clock is ticking, and the stakes are higher than ever. Will Rachel and Jack be able to catch the Timekeeper before he dies, or will he continue to haunt the ages, leaving a legacy of blood and terror?"
